objective: Deliver Agent Runtime + Harness Engineering's two contracts and the two requirements that govern the actor performing the work, in four atomic packages. Package 1 delivered C-22, the bounded harness task: the canonical harness elements parsed from BOTH canonical documents and reconciled positionally, with boundedness enforced structurally so an unbounded task cannot be constructed. Package 2 delivered C-23, the context package: the admissible context kinds parsed from `MS §Context Compiler`, provenance required per item, the C-09 no-secret guard reused rather than reimplemented, and a `context_hash` the accepted C-14 provenance record binds to. Package 3 delivered ARK-REQ-0050's structural role/backend separation and ARK-REQ-0051's two prohibitions, the latter enforced in `control.policy` because the register owns it there. Package 4 delivers the composed journey, the traceability record, this report and the single gate run. `MS §Harness Engineering` states the objective in one line: the primitive is not "send a prompt", it is "execute a bounded engineering task".

state_machine_capability_changes: NO STATE MACHINE WAS ADDED OR CHANGED. The canonical count stays 12, reconciled against STATE_MACHINES.md on every run by the live control. THE CAPABILITY CHANGE IS THE BOUNDED TASK ITSELF: before Phase 10 an engineering task had no expressible form; it now has exactly one, and that form cannot be constructed unbounded because every canonical harness element is a required field with no default under extra="forbid". A context package likewise cannot carry a kind the canonical document does not admit, cannot carry an item without provenance, and cannot carry a raw secret. An agent role cannot hold provider state, and no actor - agent or otherwise - can accept its own output. WHAT DID NOT CHANGE: no agent runtime, dispatcher or task executor exists, and a control over the shipping source asserts none is present. Phase 10 delivers the contracts a bounded engineering task is made of and the prohibitions that govern the actor performing it; it does not deliver the runtime that would perform one.

limitations: STATED PLAINLY. (1) NO AGENT RUNTIME EXISTS. Phase 10 delivers the contracts a bounded engineering task is made of and the prohibitions that govern the actor performing it. Nothing here dispatches, executes, schedules or runs a task, and a control over the shipping source asserts no dispatcher or executor is present. Do not read "Agent Runtime + Harness Engineering" as meaning a runtime was built. (2) NO CONTEXT COMPILER EXISTS. C-23 is the compiler's OUTPUT contract; nothing in this phase selects context, reads a repository or ranks relevance. (3) ARK-REQ-0051 IS A POLICY DECISION, NOT A WRITE-PATH INTERCEPT. AgentAuthority answers whether an actor may mutate a canonical requirement or accept its own output; the file-write path that would consult it on every write is a later phase's, and this report does not claim one. The pre-existing acceptance-path mechanism (rescoring_authorization.forbidden_issuers) is narrower, lives in acceptance.engine and governs GOV-001 re-scoring only; it was not counted toward this discharge. (4) `prop` evidence is exhaustive over closed governed vocabularies, not property-based fuzzing: hypothesis is NOT_CONFIGURED on this host and no package was installed to satisfy an evidence key. Exhaustion over a closed vocabulary is a stronger result than sampling it, but it is not the same technique and is reported as what it is. (5) OBSERVED, NOT REPAIRED, AND OUTSIDE THIS PHASE'S SCOPE: the accepted phase_9_report.json declares evidence_created as EV-0066 to EV-0068 while EVIDENCE_INDEX.md ends at EV-0065, so those identifiers resolve to no index row. Phase 8's accepted report shows the field is legitimately free-form, so no canonical rule is on its face violated and no finding is opened; this phase follows the Phase 8 form and declares evidence by artifact name rather than minting index positions. (6) OBSERVED, NOT CLAIMED AS PASS: `ruff check` under the project configuration reports pre-existing findings across the repository, dominated by F811 on pytest fixture parameters - a known false-positive pattern for the pytest idiom - with only the repo-conventional N818 in files this phase created. No accepted phase report records a ruff run, so none is recorded here and no ruff PASS is claimed. (7) The full suite was executed as an exhaustive three-part partition rather than one command, because this environment's per-invocation execution ceiling is shorter than the suite's runtime. The partition is proven by collection count (1778+348+48 = 2174 = the full collection), not asserted, and nothing is excluded, deselected or reordered.
